verdict.rationale: Jan's local OpenAI-compatible API documents tool calling on POST /v1/chat/completions, so native tool-calling in requests is first-party. Nothing in the pack shows reasoning-parser support, such as separating reasoning or thinking content in responses. That leaves roughly half the story evidenced. missing for 10: reasoning-parser support, detailed tool-calling request/response documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests

citations.quote: Supports streaming, tool calling, and multi-turn conversations
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
